text:
Mother mine,

tender little mother,

let me tell you

the sweetest words.


This body is yours,

you gathered it like a bouquet;

let me tumble it

across your lap.


You pretend to be a leaf

and I will be the dew;

and in your wild arms

hold me hanging there.


Mother mine,

my whole entire world,

let me tell you

my deepest endearments.

translation.title: Mother Mine…
translation.editorial_note: Reuses a reviewed translation of the identical source body.
